messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — PR #61420 is queued for canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need runtime + security owners to sign off. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/61420. Summary: adapt prefetch TTL, change cache eviction ordering. No schema changes. @runtime @security :eyes:

Ryan Patel: I'll take runtime. Quick question — does this change eviction heuristics that might affect hot-path latency? If yes, I need a quick perf run (p95/p99) on the canary config after deploy.

Samir Khan: On security: looks reasonable from a surface review. Two asks: 1) confirm KMS key usage and key alias (no plaintext key material in logs), 2) add a test asserting no sensitive metadata is included in cache keys. Can you paste the config snippet?

Maria Chen: thx — config snippet below:
```yaml
cache:
  prefetch_ttl: 180
  eviction_order: lru_ms
kms:
  key_alias: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyR
  encrypt_logs: true
logging:
  redact_cache_keys: true
```

Maria Chen: also added unit test tests/test_prefetch_ttl.py and CI passed on my branch. I annotated the PR with where the eviction change lives. pinging @eng-sre to confirm canary window scheduling. :pray:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-19 09:00 PT (id: canary-20260319-09).

Ryan Patel: I'll run microbench on that canary instance once it's up and post p95/p99 and error rate within the first hour. :thumbsup:

Samir Khan: I'll review the KMS touchpoints and add a short security checklist comment on the PR. Expect final OK today unless I find logging leakage.
